response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, exposure to agentic workflows via MCP tooling, and a proven track record in distributed systems and open-source leadership, but lacks demonstrable production-scale experience in fintech infrastructure, multi-agent AI systems with real-time financial decisioning, or engineering leadership at the CTO level — key requirements for this role.
strengths: Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks (MCP) and event-driven systems
Proven ability to build and ship complex distributed systems across languages and domains
Strong open-source leadership and technical communication via workshops and public projects
concerns: No clear evidence of building or operating multi-agent AI systems in regulated fintech environments
Lacks documented experience scaling engineering teams from 10+ to 30+ or leading technical leadership layers
No demonstrated background in credit risk, working-capital algorithms, or financial compliance infrastructure
